title: THE LONG WAY BACK · XVIII · The flats by moon
venue: the sabbatical · never posted · found in Box 9
logline: Stop eighteen: a bay at night under a full moon with two dogs on the flats, one his and one not, howling at nothing, and a crab climbing out of a channel between them. The card: a moon, two dogs, a crab. The traveler has drawn this card before without knowing it was one.

panels.composition: Tier 1: mudflats at night under a full moon, two dogs far apart with their heads up, a channel between them.

notes: XVIII. The Moon. The crab flyer's crab, the strip's dog, the flats: he'd drawn the card for twelve years.
